fetch: WHATWG Fetch: the global request function
method: WHATWG Fetch: RequestInit key naming the HTTP method
ok: WHATWG Fetch: Response field, true for a 2xx status
status: WHATWG Fetch: Response field holding the status code
json: WHATWG Fetch: Response method reading the body as JSON
text: WHATWG Fetch: Response method reading the body as text
body: WHATWG Fetch: Response field holding the body stream
headers: WHATWG Fetch: Response field holding the headers
global: suss: marker for a name that is not imported from a module
statusCode: suss: response field the binding carries
